evidence.section: Measurement of neutralizing antibodies against live viruses
evidence.quote: Virus titers were measured in Vero E6 (C1008) cells, as defined by plaque forming units (PFU) per ml, in a 6-well plate format in quadruplicate technical replicates for accuracy.
